title: Uhlu Lwanamuhla
subtitle: Maka lezi zinto njalo ekuseni. Kuthatha imizuzwana engu-30.
q_fridge_hint: Thepha Yebo uma ifriji yakho ibanda kakhulu. Faka isibalo uma uneThemomitha.
q_freezer_hint: Thepha Yebo uma u-ice cream uqinile. Faka isibalo uma uneThemomitha.
freezer_sign_aria: Thepha ukushintsha phakathi kwangaphansi kuka 0 nangenhla kuka 0
freezer_sign_hint: Thepha inkinobho ukuze ushintshe — ama-freezer ngokuvamile angaphansi kuka 0.
q_storage: Izindawo zokugcina ukudla zihlelekile futhi zihlanzekile?
q_waste_bins: Amabhokisi kadoti akhishiwe futhi indawo ihlanzekile?
q_waste_bins_hint: Amabhokisi angaphakathi nangaphandle — amasaka akhishiwe, indawo ishanyelwe.
q_expired: Ikhona into ephelelwe yisikhathi esisusiwe namuhla?
expired_hint_one: Kukhona umkhiqizo ongu-{count} onokuphelelwa yisikhathi noma ophelela namuhla.
expired_hint_other: Kukhona imikhiqizo engu-{count} enokuphelelwa yisikhathi noma ephelela namuhla.
reminder_aria: Uhlu lwanamuhla alukapheli — thinta ukuze uvule
intro_body: Thinta le nkinobho njalo ekuseni ukuze uhlole ifriji yakho, i-freezer, ukuhlanza, nezinto eziphelelwe yisikhathi. Kuthatha cishe imizuzwana engama-30.
intro_why: Lokhu kukusiza ukuthi uhlale ulungele ukuhlolwa kwezempilo futhi kugcine isitolo sakho siphephile.
status_todo: Yenza uhlu lwanamuhla — kuthatha imizuzwana engu-30
settings_section_desc: Vala lezi uma isitolo sakho singenaso — ziyosuswa ohlwini lwansuku zonke.
